#### List:

- Kinetics
- CVS effects
- CNS effects

#### Kinetics:

+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                         | **Propofol (PPF)**                    | **Sevoflurane (SF)**                                                   | **Implication**                                                     |
+=========================+=======================================+========================================================================+=====================================================================+
| Decrement times         | 10 min                                | 10 min                                                                 | Similar after short infusion                                        |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
| - 1h 50% DT             | 60 min                                | 20 min                                                                 | PPF much slower after long infusion                                 |
| - 1h 90% DT             |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
| - 8h 50% DT             | 45 min                                | 20 min                                                                 |                                                                     |
| - 8h 90% DT             |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | 300 min                               | 120 min                                                                |                                                                     |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Absorption              | Straight into central compartment     | Inhalational: diffusion across membrane down partial pressure gradient | PPF bolus → more rapid ↑in Cp and Ce → better if sudden stimulation |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Distribution            | Accumulation in many tissues          | Accumulation in many tissues                                           | Multicompartment modelling required                                 |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Highly lipid soluble (LS)             | High fat-blood coefficient                                             | - 3 for PPF (V1-2-3)                                                |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        | - 5 for SF (vessel rich, lean, intermediate, vessel poor, fat)      |
|                         | V~D~ 4L/kg                            | V~D~ unknown                                                           |                                                                     |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | 98% PPB, esp albumin                  | Dissolved in blood cells, fat                                          |                                                                     |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism              | Extensive\>99%                        | 2-5% metabolism                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Rapid (Cl 30-60mL/kg/min)             | Phase 1: CYP2E1 \> other                                               |                                                                     |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Phase 1: 2B6, 2C9, 3A4                | Small contribution to offset                                           |                                                                     |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Phase 2: glucuronidation or sulfation |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Sites: liver + ? kidney ? lung        |                                                                        |                                                                     |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolites             | No active metabolites                 | Endogenous: fluorides and hexafluoroisopropanol                        | No significant effects                                              |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Quinol → green urine                  | With CO~2~ absorber: compound A                                        | Compound A does not reach toxic conc in humans                      |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Excretion               | 0.3% PPF → urine                      | 95-98%                                                                 | S: ↑offset if ↑V~A~, ↑FGF                                           |
|                         |                                       |                                                                        |                                                                     |
|                         | Metabolites → urine                   | Lungs \>\>\> skin                                                      | P: offset can’t be sped up                                          |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect of liver failure | Minimal                               | Minimal                                                                | Both safe                                                           |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect of renal failure | Minimal                               | Minimal                                                                | Both safe                                                           |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Risk of accumulation    | IV: indefinite accumulation possible  | Inhaled: cannot exceed inspired partial pressure                       |                                                                     |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### CVS effects:

+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                            | **Propofol**           | **Sevoflurane**                         | **Implication**                                                          |
+============================+========================+=========================================+==========================================================================+
| Inotropy                   | ↓                      | ↔/↓                                     | SF may be preferable for patients with haemodynamic instability, sepsis. |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+                                                                          |
| Heart rate                 | ↓ (blunted baro resp)  | ↔/↑\                                    |                                                                          |
|                            |                        | (↑↑in Guedel’s stage 2)                 |                                                                          |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+                                                                          |
| Cardiac output             | ↓                      | ↔/↓                                     |                                                                          |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+                                                                          |
| SVR                        | ↓↓                     | ↓                                       |                                                                          |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+                                                                          |
| mAP                        | ↓↓                     | ↓                                       |                                                                          |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| PVR                        | ↓↓                     | ↓                                       | PPF ? preserves HPV in one lung ventilation                              |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Coronary blood flow        | ↓                      | ↑                                       | SF ? safer if IHD                                                        |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Ischaemic pre-conditioning | No                     | Y (activate ATP-sensitive K^+^ channel) | SF ? safer if IHD                                                        |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ↑ QTc                      | No                     | Yes                                     | Not significant                                                          |
+----------------------------+------------------------+-----------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
